commit.message:
feat(viewport): orthographic projection mode - browser radios and bare P flip it

- `Camera` grows a `projection: ProjectionMode` field (Perspective stays
  the default). The mode rides the camera itself, so `mvp`, `ray_through`
  and `dolly_cursor` share one decision by construction and every
  existing `mvp(aspect)` call site keeps working untouched. `frame`,
  `toward` and `oriented` carry it; orbit, pan and zoom leave it alone.
- Ortho branch: an affine matrix (clip.w is 1, linear depth), view
  half-height `dist * tan(30 deg)` - exactly the height perspective
  sees at the target plane - so the mode switch never jumps the framing
  and `dist` keeps spelling zoom for orbit, pan and frame alike. Pick
  rays go parallel through the same matrix, and the ortho dolly holds
  the world point under the cursor.
- It is ephemeral view state, like the Solids radios: a direct field
  flip through `actions::toggle_projection`, never a command, never
  saved in the project; the sim's `PreviewCamera` stays perspective.
- UI: a Projection radio row (Perspective / Ortho) under the Solids
  radios in the browser pane, and bare P in `shortcuts()` toggles it
  with the same guard as bare F, so Ctrl+P keeps its post dialog and
  the Alt lanes stay clear.

Pins: `projection_tests` in law_tests - the matrix is affine where
perspective is not, ortho rays are parallel and the cursor closes
through the matrix, sizes ignore depth where perspective shrinks them,
the mode switch agrees at the target plane, the ortho dolly holds the
cursor point, and the camera transforms carry the mode. In the egui
shell: `projection_radios_flip_the_viewport_mode` (real pointer
events, queues nothing) and `bare_p_flips_projection_without_a_command`
(P toggles, Ctrl+P still arms PostProgramDialog). Snapshots rebuilt
for the new browser row.

Fixes #434
